featured_reviews.name: Sushil Khanal
featured_reviews.review_text: Guitar learning seemed difficult to me at first, but after joining this class, everything became much easier. When I joined, I had no knowledge of guitar at all. My teacher patiently guided me step by step and helped me build confidence. Every class is interesting and motivating. The environment of this class is very friendly and positive, which makes learning even easier. This is a great place for beginners to learn guitar. Special thanks to my teacher—whatever I can play today is largely because of their guidance and support. Highly recommended🎸

featured_reviews.name: Bhoomi Karia
featured_reviews.review_text:
it’s almost been a month since i started learning the electric guitar and i came in with absolutely zero musical background. rahul sir was the one who made me realise that i didn’t need any prior experience. from day one he assured me that if I was willing to learn he would teach me properly.

he is truly a man of many talents there honestly doesn’t seem to be an instrument he can’t play and that’s incredibly inspiring to see as a student.

a special mention goes to shubham sir who teaches me directly i have genuinely never met someone so patient he explains everything so well never gets frustrated and most importantly never judges me no matter how badly i play something. that has made a huge difference to my confidence and learning experience.

i also love the atmosphere here. i have seen young kids learning i have seen adults learning but it never feels like a strange mix. everyone is just there because they love music.

and of course a special thanks to samiksha who handles all my class scheduling and somehow manages to make my life much easier.

i never thought i would find something i enjoy this much at 21 but i absolutely love playing the electric guitar now. joining these classes has been one of the best decisions i have made and i am excited to keep learning.

I had scheduled a demo class for my child 2–3 days in advance, but the academy did not turn up as planned. Till the last minute, they kept sending invites and reminders—even though their teacher never showed up. To attend this class, I had rescheduled all of my child’s other classes and even adjusted my office timings. This was especially disappointing as it was for a small child, and I expected the academy to value our time and the child’s interest. Clear communication and reliability are crucial, especially when
working with young children. I hope the academy takes this feedback seriously and improves their scheduling and commitment.

featured_reviews.name: Amita Jaggi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm a bit disappointed with our experience at Artium. My daughter has been taking online classes, but there are a few ongoing issues. Sometimes the internet on the teacher's side doesn't work properly, and classes often end 5 to 7 minutes early. On top of that, another 5 to 7 minutes are spent just booking the next slot. While scheduling is understandable, losing a significant chunk of class time each session—especially with the high fees—is frustrating.

Over 10 sessions, we’ve lost nearly an entire class's worth of time. It really feels like there’s no accountability for ensuring the full class time is used.

My daughter even asked me not to mention any teacher's name, worrying it might affect them. But this is a broader issue—one that the team should be monitoring. Are all students getting the full hour they’re paying for?

I’ve attached screenshots as proof. Sadly, I won't be enrolling my daughter again. I feel in-person learning will be more effective and reliable.

featured_reviews.name: Rajvi Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased the Platinum singing class package from Atrium Academy and paid the full amount upfront at the end of January. As part of the package, we were promised a music studio kit delivered to our address, but it still hasn’t arrived.
Since then, I have had to chase this issue 5–6 times. Each time I was told there had been a problem with the order, that it had been cancelled and reordered, and that the matter had been escalated with someone expected to contact me within 48 hours. In most cases, I did not receive the follow-up that was promised.
On one occasion, someone contacted me to check whether the kit had been delivered. When I confirmed it had not, I was told it appeared to be a system glitch and that the order had actually been cancelled. After numerous attempts and speaking to different teams, I was finally given a point of contact who genuinely tried her best to help and even attempted to support while she was on medical leave. But again, no further follow-up as promised.
I have now been informed that Amazon has cancelled the order for the fourth time. Overall, I am highly disappointed with the level of service. The academy requires full upfront payment but has still not delivered a key part of the package, despite repeated chasing from my side.

featured_reviews.name: Milan Savla
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently joined Nikhil Sir’s drumming classes, and in a short time, I’ve seen remarkable improvement. He has helped me understand many concepts clearly, both theoretically and practically.

His teaching style is a great blend of traditional methods and a fun, engaging approach, which makes learning easier and keeps you motivated to improve. He creates a very comfortable environment for his students, understands their strengths and weaknesses, and tailors his teaching accordingly.

His experience and talent truly speak for themselves.

If you’re thinking of learning drumming, Nikhil Sir is definitely the right choice. Highly recommended!!

featured_reviews.name: Luke Kunder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I feel extremely fortunate to be learning drums from Nikhil Shah Sir. He is one of the most skillful and knowledgeable people I have met, and at the same time one of the most friendly and approachable mentors. What makes his teaching special is the way Sir explains even complex techniques using very simple and relatable examples, making it easy to understand and apply.

Beyond just drums, Sir often shares interesting general knowledge and experiences about music and many other things he knows, which makes every class engaging and inspiring. His passion for teaching truly reflects in the way Sir interacts with students.

I always look forward to attending Sir’s classes because every session is an opportunity to learn something new and improve my skills. I am grateful to have such a supportive and inspiring teacher guiding my musical journey.

featured_reviews.name: Shiv Hojage
featured_reviews.review_text: Nikhil sir is the best drum teacher ive ever seen, I appreciate your teaching style, your encouragement, and I can truly say that I enjoy learning about the drums and have even more fun playing thanks to you! I learn something new in each session and I enjoy the atmosphere. Its is ranked 1st in Google, Thank you and keep up the great work!
